name: meraj-media-player
description: Offline-first local audio player for Android

scripts.android:build: npm run build && (test -d android || npx cap add android) && node scripts/integrate-native-media.cjs && node scripts/strip-internet-permission.cjs && npx cap sync android && node scripts/integrate-native-media.cjs && node scripts/strip-internet-permission.cjs && cd android && (if [ -f gradlew ]; then chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug; else gradlew.bat assembleDebug; fi)
